inputs.text: [excited] PAK… ee… SEF… ah… loh… SOR… us. [curious] "Pachy," in Greek, means thick. "Cephalo" is head. And "saurus" is lizard.
[happily] Exactly, [warmly] with a skull as hard as a helmet. He lived in North America, seventy million years ago — [gently] at the same time as Triceratops.
[curious] So he's a cousin of Tritri's?
[confident] A cousin of the horned dinos, yes, [pauses] but his weapon is his head, not horns.
